name: framer
description: Read and edit Framer projects through the Framer MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Open a Framer project by URL and work on it from a conversation: inspect pages, components, styles, and CMS collections, and make changes on a branch you can review in Framer.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the pages and CMS collections in this Framer project
Add a pricing section to the home page of my Framer site
Find text on my Framer site that doesn’t match our tone of voice
